'''Kenneth E. Emerson''' (November 9, 1931 – October 30, 2010) was an American [[chemist]].

== Life and career ==
Emerson was born in [[Pasadena, California]]. He moved to [[Urbana, Illinois]] in 1946. He attended and graduated from [[Urbana High School (Illinois)|Urbana High School]]. After graduating, he attended [[Harvard College]], and he served in the [[United States Army]]. After his discharge in 1955, he attended [[Postgraduate education|graduate schools]] in [[Minnesota]] and [[Oregon]], and earned his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in 1961, which earning his degree, he worked as a [[postdoctoral researcher|postdoctoral fellow]] at the [[California Institute of Technology]].<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/legacyremembers/ken-emerson-obituary?id=48421064|title=Ken Emerson|work=Legacy|access-date=October 30, 2026|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref>

Emerson served as a professor in the department of [[chemistry]] at [[Montana State University]] from 1962 to 1993.<ref name="a" /> During his years as a professor, in 1970, he was named a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|fellow]] of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic?field_last_name_value=All&field_address_city=All&field_address_when_elected_administrative_area=All&field_address_when_elected_country_code=All&field_year_elected=&field_primary_aaas_section=All&field_status_value=All&field_year_status_changed_value=&name_combine=Emerson&field_institutional_affiliation_value=|title=Historic Fellows|work=[[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]|access-date=October 30, 2026}}</ref>

== Death ==
Emerson died in [[Bozeman, Montana]] on October 30, 2010, at the age of 78.<ref name="a" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/bozemandailychronicle/name/ken-emerson-obituary?id=48421064|title=Ken Emerson Obituary (1931-2010)|work=[[Bozeman Daily Chronicle]]|date=November 7, 2010|access-date=November 2, 2026|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref>
